source: docs/dataset-spec.md §2 (Arabizi house and variant profiles) and the lint table
notes: Written-as-pronounced cannot be linted; only these mechanical house/variant markers are.
house: no 6/9/8 as letters, no kh, no 3', no q outside /q/-words, article el (not al/l/ll), no ق-deletion forms. Names (scenario aliases) and declared CS insertions are exempt.
q_words: words that keep /q/ in the house profile (spec: qanoon, el Qahera); matched as a word start.
